notes.content:
Your choices change the [b]GENRE[/b] of the story!

[b]Almost EVERY NPC LIES to you[/b] at some point in the game!

Hello everyone!

We are happy to announce that we have added Steam Achievement to Fading Hearts! Now you can know what to spoil and what not to spoil to everyone!

Take care and enjoy everyone!

Also please remember that NEARLY EVERY NPC LIES TO YOU at some point in the game. Just a friendly hint.

notes.title: Version V2 B Plus Patch Coming Soon
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

This is to let everyone know that a patch is coming out soon for an additional user interface settings, typos and rewrite fixes were done. 

Some key plot hints in the first rewrite patch was lost. Those are being added back in. 

Also one of the game's "illusions" was a little too difficult to figure out without using meta-reasoning. More hints to the true nature of the illusion are going to be added.

Just keep in mind that the storyline can move on with or without the player and that nearly every NPC lies to you at some point.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Fading Hearts
notes.content:
Fading Hearts is Now Available on Steam and is 25% off to celebrate!
Live a life of adventure or a normal life! A game with true choices!

An interactive story/game where you play the role of Ryou, a seemingly normal high school student in the land of Sorayama. Solve the mysteries that surround him while maintaining his friendships and saving Claire. Remain ignorant of the secrets and live a normal life or choose to learn the truth. Be careful where you put your priorities for it may prove fatal.
